aria: Animated recap of the Knicks' 109 to 97 road win at Cleveland: Jalen Brunson's pull-up jumper with 2:37 left in the first half, quarter-by-quarter scoring, his 31 points, the top scorers, how the Knicks won, and the next game against Milwaukee.
notes: Box score from the Knicks' 109–97 win over the Cleveland Cavaliers in Cleveland on Nov 7, 2026, from StatMuse's full box score, with game details from the New York Daily News (via Yahoo Sports), SNY (via Yahoo Sports), Fear the Sword (via Yahoo Sports), Hoops Wire, AFP (via The42), NY Knicks News and the CBS Sports gametracker. All 109 Knicks points and all 97 Cavaliers points are accounted for in the box score. The quarter scores are CBS Sports' line score; the 19-point lead is from AFP and SNY (88–69 late in the third), and Cleveland's 6-point lead is SNY's. Second-chance points (26–8) are from Hoops Wire and AFP. The Bucks' record and the Knicks' standing are from the site's standings.

The play of the game is an original illustration of Jalen Brunson's pull-up jumper with 2:37 left in the second quarter, which made it 52–47 (the Daily News' description) after his four-point play had made it 50–45 at 3:23. It came during an 18-point second quarter for Brunson (AFP, SNY). The recaps don't describe the shot beyond a pull-up, so it is drawn as a plain pull-up. His change of pace is shown as a hesitation on the way into the shot, with a fading afterimage where he pauses: a stylized signature, not a description of this possession. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the New York Knicks or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Brunson’s listed 6-foot-2 and 190 pounds (RealGM), with arms scaled to his 6-foot-4 wingspan at the 2018 draft combine (NBC Sports). It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
